subject: Coordinated kickoff windows for Starbridge discovery
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@starbridge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + discovery scheduling for Starbridge / Redwood demo

Hi Samir — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the interest in Redwood.

I want to get a short initial discovery on the calendar (30–45 minutes) to surface the integration surface, security constraints, and success criteria before we schedule a product walkthrough. Karthik (SE) will join for technical Q&A.

Here are a few slots from our side next week (all PDT):
- Tue 6/1, 10:30–11:15am
- Tue 6/1, 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed 6/2, 1:00–1:45pm

If none work, tell us the couple of windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Please confirm who from your team will join (engineering lead + any procurement/security folks), and flag any topics you want prioritized (e.g., data residency, SOC2, network/firewall requirements).

I’ll attach a one-page pre-call checklist and a brief evidence request for the security owners so they can have anything ready if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@starbridge.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery scheduling for Starbridge / Redwood demo

Thanks Hannah — excited to connect. Quick notes:
- Please include our engineering lead, Lena Brooks (lena.brooks@starbridge.io).
- Loop in procurement: procurement@starbridge.io (they need to approve any pilot/PO timelines).
- Calendar constraints: our core engineering hours are 11am–4pm PDT; avoid Thursdays if possible.
- Primary interests: security posture (SOC2, logging/audit), network integration (VPC peering / private deployment), and any ROI examples for high-throughput inference.

Any of the Tue/Wed slots should be fine for us except we prefer afternoons. If you could propose one or two afternoon slots that work for Karthik, that’d be ideal.

Also, we’ll need a short prep list for our security folks so they know what evidence to pull in advance.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of AI Partnerships | Starbridge Systems
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@starbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery scheduling for Starbridge / Redwood demo

On Thu, May 27, 2027 at 10:03 AM Samir Patel <samir.patel@starbridge.io> wrote:
> Thanks Hannah — excited to connect. Quick notes:
> - Please include our engineering lead, Lena Brooks (lena.brooks@starbridge.io).
> - Loop in procurement: procurement@starbridge.io (they need to approve any pilot/PO timelines).

Thanks for the context, Samir. Two afternoon options from our side that keep the meeting within 45 minutes and give us time for Q&A:
- Tue 6/1, 2:00–2:45pm PDT
- Wed 6/2, 1:00–1:45pm PDT

If you confirm one of those I’ll prepare a focused tech agenda: 10 min context from Samir (your goals), 15 min walkthrough of architectural options (hosted vs private), 15 min deep-dive on security/integration + next steps.

Can you confirm whether your environment is: AWS (account-level peering) or private data center? Also flag if you expect any air-gapped/on-prem constraints — we’ll bring up the on-prem packaging at a high level if so.

Attaching a short pre-call checklist I usually send to customers so security/procurement know what to expect.

—
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@starbridge.io>, Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@starbridge.io>, procurement@starbridge.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming Wed 6/2 1:00pm PDT — Starbridge discovery + pre-call materials

Great — thanks for the quick replies. Per Karthik’s note, we’ve tentatively scheduled:

Event: Starbridge x Redwood — Initial discovery (30–45m)
When: Wed, 2 June 2027, 1:00–1:45pm PDT
Where: https://cal.redwood.com/event/eq3k-6b2d-starbridge-discovery (calendar invite sent)

Agenda (high level):
- 10m: Introductions & desired outcomes (Samir / Lena)
- 15m: Architecture options + demo highlights (Karthik)
- 15m: Security/integration Q&A + next steps (open)

Attached: redwood-precall-checklist.pdf (one page), soc2-evidence-request.pdf (summary of typical artifacts to surface), and a draft SOW template for pilots (sow-draft.docx). Please share any additional stakeholders to add to the invite.

A couple of prep asks for your security/procurement teams so the meeting is effective:
- If available, have a SOC2 summary or point to your compliance contact.
- Confirm whether the deployment target is AWS (account id/helpful CIDRs) or an on-prem environment.
- If procurement expects contract redlines ahead of a pilot, let us know timeline constraints — Ben (cc’d) will coordinate contracting on our side.

If anything changes to the attendee list or timing, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-precall-checklist.pdf (attachment), soc2-evidence-request.pdf (attachment), sow-draft.docx (attachment)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@starbridge.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@starbridge.io>, procurement@starbridge.io
Date: 2027-05-27T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming Wed 6/2 1:00pm PDT — Starbridge discovery + pre-call materials

Confirmed — Wed 6/2, 1:00pm PDT works for my team. Lena will join as engineering lead. Procurement noted the SOW draft and will look it over; they typically request a two-week turnaround on standard PO language but we can discuss during the meeting.

Thanks for the checklist — I’ll circulate the SOC2 summary and a short network diagram to the security contact before the call. See you both next week.

—
Samir
